title: Surface Water Resources
definition: Surface water resources refer to the renewable water found on the Earth's surface in rivers, lakes, streams, wetlands, and artificial reservoirs, primarily sustained by precipitation and snowmelt.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper I (Geographical distribution of water resources, rivers) and Paper III (Water resource management, irrigation, inter-state disputes, and environmental impact assessment).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, hydrological cycles, and basin characteristics of India's surface water.
Evaluate spatial distribution disparities, river basin potentials, and institutional frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding water allocation and river systems.
